exposure: Intra-abdominal removal of the placenta during cesarean section
Extra-abdominal removal of the placenta during cesarean section
outcome: Amount of intra-abdominal hemorrhagic fluid accumulation
Pre- and postoperative hemoglobin and hematocrit levels
cohort: 210 women undergoing cesarean section at term in a tertiary university hospital between March 2014 and January 2015
finding: Extra-abdominal removal of the placenta during cesarean section resulted in significantly less intra-abdominal hemorrhagic fluid accumulation compared to the intra-abdominal removal method, but no significant differences were found in other measured outcomes.
mod_finding: The study specifically examined two methods of placenta removal during cesarean section: extra-abdominal and intra-abdominal.
